classification.difficultyReason: Infer cylinder dimensions from the enclosing cube and compare their volumes as a percentage.

content.prompt: Express the volume of the cylinder as a percentage of the volume of the cube. Answer to 1 d.p.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 12, below the stem at left
spec.description: Upright cylinder inscribed in a cube, with a dimension arrow beneath the front base edge labelled 8 cm.
spec.mathematics: Cube side s = 8 cm. Cylinder height s and diameter s. Projection P(x,y,z) = (x + 0.44y, z + 0.38y), with x,y,z in [0,2]. Cube faces are z=0, z=2, x=0, x=2, y=0 and y=2. Cylinder axis passes through (1,1,z), radius 1. Camera lies toward negative x, negative y and positive z; the cube is depicted as a wireframe enclosure so the cylinder remains visible. Cylinder rims are projected circles. Surface silhouettes occur where the projected radial x coordinate is extremal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source dimension is visible; radius and volume calculations belong to the answer.
